name: com.jiwe.wallet-sdk
description: Jiwe public-client sign-in and player reads for Unity games. Modern path: JiweSdk.InitializeAsync, JiweSdk.Auth and JiweSdk.Rewards. The legacy credential-based API (JiweAuth, JiweWallet) remains available for existing integrations.

samples.description: One canonical sample: configure, sign in, read earned XP, switch account, sign out.
